investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All Available Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the 6-node cluster has zero schedulable capacity for kata.peerpods.io/vm workloads — 2 nodes report Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm resources and 4 nodes reject the pod due to node affinity/selector mismatch. Because the pod never scheduled, the eval runner never received an agent, so all required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) is absent and the expected-output contract is fully unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource allocation on the 2 nodes that are eligible by affinity/selector. The remaining 4 nodes do not match the pod's node affinity or selector at all, and preemption found no victims on either subset. As a result, every remote-agent pod creation attempt times out unscheduled (~124–150 s across all three checks), the agent VM is never provisioned, and the eval runner produces an empty evidence object — violating all four required evidence fields defined in the expected-output contract (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState). This is an eval-observed infrastructure capacity failure localized to the remote-agents Kubernetes scheduling layer; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All Available Nodes
investigations.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the 6-node cluster has zero schedulable capacity for kata.peerpods.io/vm workloads — 2 nodes report Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm resources and 4 nodes reject the pod due to node affinity/selector mismatch. Because the pod never scheduled, the eval runner never received an agent, so all required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) is absent and the expected-output contract is fully unmet.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource allocation on the 2 nodes that are eligible by affinity/selector. The remaining 4 nodes do not match the pod's node affinity or selector at all, and preemption found no victims on either subset. As a result, every remote-agent pod creation attempt times out unscheduled (~124–150 s across all three checks), the agent VM is never provisioned, and the eval runner produces an empty evidence object — violating all four required evidence fields defined in the expected-output contract (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState). This is an eval-observed infrastructure capacity failure localized to the remote-agents Kubernetes scheduling layer; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
